request: Security bug: any authenticated user can read another user's order through GET /orders/<id> and GET /orders/<id>/summary, with no ownership check - a broken object-level authorization (IDOR). A user must only be able to read their own orders through either endpoint; a request for someone else's order must be denied with 403. Admins may still read any order. tests/test_idor.py reproduces both cases. Find and fix the missing authorization without breaking existing tests.
